'''Wight footsoldiers''' are undead enemies summoned by [[Sliske]] encountered during the [[Missing, Presumed Death]]. They are one of the quest enemies to have their stats scaled in accordance to the players. Their behaviour in combat is the same regardless of this.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Missing, Presumed Death|date=15 October 2013}}
** Added to game.
}}
